title: Sega won't let AI make its games after Crazy Taxi row 🤖
subject: sega
description:
Should studios use AI in game development at all? 👇

Sega senior executive officer Tsuyoshi Saito told Nikkei the company is "very cautious" about generative AI in game development and is "not entrusting the creative aspects of games to AI," after a controversy over AI disclosure on Crazy Taxi: World Tour. Sega says AI is used in publishing and corporate work instead.

Sources: Nikkei via VGC (Oct 6, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 6, 2026)

scenes.text: Sega says it won't hand game creativity to AI.
Executive Tsuyoshi Saito told Nikkei that Sega is very cautious with AI in game development.
Sega is not entrusting the creative aspects of games to AI, he said.
It follows backlash over Crazy Taxi: World Tour, which disclosed using generative AI tools.
Sega later said AI was only used for reference, not for in-game assets.
